source_summary: Tall ink-and-light-wash Chinese landscape with large blank sky, central distant mountain shoreline, broad water bands, and a detailed lower foreground of bamboo, slender trees, rocks, banks, and a thatched waterside pavilion. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_distant_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the main distant mountain mass in the middle of the scroll, including the twin peaks, sloping ridges, cliff faces, vertical texture strokes, dark clustered tree dots on the slopes, soft pale washes, and the low shoreline at its base.
must_preserve: angular peak outlines and ridge linework
dry-brush cliff texture and vertical strokes
small dark tree clusters on mountain face
soft wash transitions along the mountain base

motifs.name: right_distant_shore_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the low right-side distant shoreline and rolling hills beside the central mountain, with faint ridges, clustered shrubs, and horizontal water-edge lines.
must_preserve: thin horizontal shoreline and water lines
soft misty edges where hills fade into blank space

motifs.name: middle_water_sandbars
motifs.description: Isolate the open middle water surface with long horizontal ink strokes, pale sandbar shapes, small reed-like marks, and tiny dark accents suggesting distant banks.
must_preserve: sparse dark dots and short strokes

motifs.name: left_foreground_bank_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left curving riverbank and stream entrance, including the sloped bank, dark shrub clusters, small conifer-like trees, and thin water/path lines leading inward.

motifs.name: thatched_waterside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small thatched pavilion or hut near the lower-left foreground water, including the straw roof, supporting posts, dark roof-edge line, and minimal platform/base strokes.
must_preserve: open airy space beneath the roof

motifs.name: foreground_bamboo_clump
motifs.description: Isolate the arcing bamboo cluster in the lower center-left, with bending stems, narrow leaves, branching sprays, and light-to-dark ink variations.
must_preserve: darker leaf clusters mixed with pale wash stems

motifs.name: tall_foreground_tree_group
motifs.description: Isolate the tall slender foreground trees on the lower right, including multiple pale trunks, sparse branching, dotted leaf clusters, and dark ink accents along the trunks and foliage.

motifs.name: foreground_rock_platform
motifs.description: Isolate the broad foreground rock platform across the lower right and center, including rounded boulders, dark moss dots, layered rock contours, and the uneven ground supporting the trees.
must_preserve: soft grey ink wash on rock faces
uneven ground edge at the bottom

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
